verdict_html: Not enough settled videos yet to say anything. Lessons appear here once at least three videos are 48 hours old.
notes: Small sample. {{n_videos}} public videos with {{views_range}} views each. Curves move while a video is young, so treat anything under 48 hours old as provisional.

Where the numbers come from. Retention is TikTok Studio's own per-second curve, pulled fresh every run from your signed-in Studio tab. Transcripts are local Whisper with word timestamps. Visual notes are one Gemini watch pass per video when a Gemini key is set; the first frames shown are real frames. Private and under-review posts are skipped.
